data.title: bn-ful4: deterministic skeleton-trial ledger and referee rubric
data.description: Full-range review of the committed bn-ful4 rubric, schemas, fixtures, and adversarial tests after producer dependencies merged.

data.body: P1. The grader still accepts cloned supplied-workspace state as two independent preparations. The loop validates each lead and TOML independently, then explicitly excludes the three native files from cross-cell equality checks. It never rejects a duplicate generated UUID or supplied lead ID, and the later lead identity check uses a cell-local key at line 3114. I used the checked-in synthetic fixture with its test key, one shared native-form supplied ID, and the same scourge.toml, demo-owner and SQLite digests in both supplied slots. After rebuilding the linked context and assignment receipts, all four cells and the aggregate scored passed. Native demo generates a workspace UUID and normal lead creation mints a separate UUID. Require distinct frozen workspace IDs and supplied leads across independent slots, preserve the existing three exact path exceptions, and add a regression with otherwise valid duplicate identities.

data.reason: Exact target 5d0bef38c4d3ec84f97060e2c22785b7b904fe44, tree 1e64e59f25c6181319d1469d81fd59c8c2ebbc0f, persisted base fe2242ba16934552992070a993258365b3fcae16. Block on th-9fq6xz. An offline test-key replay with reused native workspace state and supplied-lead identity passes all four cells and the aggregate. The assignment must reject identity reuse across independently prepared cells.

data.body: Fixed in f7847e4778a332119fc0541356a56e965fdf1fbc (tree ad7c36934c13b7add2aecfa610d2ba0144eebe15). Replay extracts each workspace UUID from its canonical native TOML after binding those bytes to the frozen visible inventory. The four assigned workspace UUIDs and the two supplied lead IDs must be distinct. The three native workspace path exceptions and shared input checks still apply. The signed synthetic regression rebuilds the local context and assignment bindings after cloning the supplied workspace and lead. The old target passed the same fixture across all four cells and the aggregate. The new revision rejects workspace reuse alone, lead reuse alone, and both together. Four distinct workspaces and two distinct supplied leads pass. The focused rubric suite passed 123 of 123 tests. Serial offline just check and git diff --check passed.

data.reason: Verified at f7847e4778a332119fc0541356a56e965fdf1fbc. Identical signed synthetic cloned evidence passed all four cells at the prior target and is now refused. Workspace reuse across tracks and under a distinct artifact path is refused. Focused tests independently reject each cloned identity and accept distinct inventory-bound workspaces and supplied leads.

Reviewed the full persisted range fe2242ba16934552992070a993258365b3fcae16 through f7847e4778a332119fc0541356a56e965fdf1fbc, tree ad7c36934c13b7add2aecfa610d2ba0144eebe15. The former cloned-state false pass now fails with identical signed inputs. Four distinct inventory-bound native UUIDs and both independent supplied IDs are required. Honest per-workspace digests and Teapot paths pass. Signed launch prompt and subprocess roles remain bound, authoritative native replay and decoy/F-37 checks still gate claims, and invalid captures retain their denominators without scores. Sixteen freshly run targeted offline tests passed, git diff --check passed, and the archived 123-test and serial offline just-check logs match their recorded digests. Native qualification remains a separate integration step.
